=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Expense is identified by ExpenseId.
ExpenseId is a value of type Integer.
Employee is a value of type String.
Amount is a value of type Integer.
Category is a value of type String.
Chain is a value of type String.

=== Fact Types ===
Expense is submitted by Employee
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - employee: Employee (String)

Expense has Amount
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - amount: Amount (Integer)

Expense is in Category
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - category: Category (String)

Expense is approved
  - expense: Expense (Integer)

Expense is approved by Chain
  - expense: Expense (Integer)
  - chain: Chain (String)
